content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
This sovereign digital commerce stack offers a 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10% fee, resulting in significant retained revenue for creators.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Can I sell digital products like ebooks and templates online without using PayPal or Stripe? Yes, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack built on free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments to host, deliver, and process payments for your digital products without relying on external platforms or services.
This infrastructure solution is built on the principles of self-ownership and sovereignty, giving creators full control and ownership over their digital commerce stack.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those interested in learning more about building and deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, we recommend checking out the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates for a successful deployment. Additionally, you can browse our product line at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our available options and pricing.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: First, choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, configure order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, integrate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification using NOWPayments. Additionally, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit for instant access to all the necessary blueprints and templates.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I connect my NOWPayments account to my digital commerce stack?

To connect your NOWPayments account, you'll need to generate a new API key and paste it into your digital commerce stack's backend logic. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and seamless integration with your NOWPayments account.
Can I use my own domain name with this sovereign digital commerce stack?
Yes, you can use your own domain name with this infrastructure solution by setting up a custom domain on your hosting platform and configuring DNS records accordingly.
How do I handle refunds and customer support with this infrastructure solution?

To handle refunds and customer support, you can use a combination of Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic to create a seamless customer experience.
Can I use this sovereign digital commerce stack for other types of digital products?
Yes, this infrastructure solution can be adapted for other types of digital products, including music, videos, and software, by using the same components and configuration.
How do I scale my digital commerce stack as my business grows?
To scale your digital commerce stack, you can use the same components and configuration, but with increased resources and optimization to handle higher traffic and sales volumes.
Can I use this sovereign digital commerce stack with other cryptocurrency payment processors?
Yes, you can use other cryptocurrency payment processors like BSC, Solana, or TRON with this infrastructure solution by simply replacing NOWPayments with the new payment processor.
